ceremony.name: Community member onboarding (applicant and community)
ceremony.choreography: docs/30-onboarding-vetting-ceremonies.md section 3: discover, apply, the administrator's decision (a harness-held identity: the community's own console), the applicant's polls, then the optional reciprocal exchange (solicit, ask, vmc), at the task versions the platforms serve (manifest 0.4, submit 0.3). The wallet is the applicant; the community is the VTC.
